name: Urueña

climate: Tempranillo sits in its sweet spot, so the wines can show the style it is known for.

terms: A wine from a pago, a named rural site with its own soil and microclimate. All its grapes must grow there.
Young wine, sold with little or no aging. Some see a few months in oak.

blurb.text: A single-estate Vino de Pago of 78 hectares in the municipality of Urueña, Valladolid province, in Castile and León. Its rules allow rosé and red wine from four red grapes: Tempranillo, Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot and Syrah.
